title: The Valid ticket for the train
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：valid　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 valid 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the engineer wrote of ① a valid ticket for the train in the manual, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② so valid that nobody in the workshop would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the engineer, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the valid ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the valid ticket for the train that anybody there had ever seen, or so the manual for April 1964 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too valid to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the valid ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a valid reason for the change, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as valid as the reason for the change they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was valid or not, and he said so.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manual. What the line asked for was ⑦ something valid, and nothing besides. The worker from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite valid; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the manual kept the names of the valid ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980, twice over, she wrote of another valid ticket for the train in the same manual, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less valid than anybody had expected. ⑩ The valid reason for the change that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1982, was the one she could never quite name; the valid ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有效（前置定语 a valid ticket for the train：1970 年工程师在说明书里记下的那件有效的车票）
B. adj. 有效／正当（两处加强说法：so valid that … 与 no less valid than …）
C. adj. 有效／正当（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有效（表语 too valid to do：母亲觉得它太有效，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 正当（前置定语 a valid reason for the change：叔叔把整件事称作一桩正当的理由）
F. adj. 正当（同级比较 as valid as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩变革的正当理由相比）
G. adj. 正当（后置定语 something valid：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 正当（受程度副词修饰 quite valid：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a valid ticket for the train
the valid ticket for the train that
a valid reason for the change
The valid reason for the change that

answers.why: valid 意为“有效”，1970 年工程师在说明书里记下的是“一件有效的车票”，此处作前置定语 a valid ticket for the train。
valid 意为“有效”，此处用 so valid that 结构，说它有效到车间里没人敢靠近。
valid 意为“有效”，说明书上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的有效有效的车票，等于最高级的说法。
valid 意为“有效”，母亲认为这件东西“太有效了，谁也用不上”，too valid to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
valid 意为“正当”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩正当的理由”，此处作前置定语 a valid reason for the change。
valid 意为“正当”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩变革的正当理由一样正当”，同级比较用 as valid as。
valid 意为“正当”，说明书上那半行字要的是“正当的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something valid。
valid 意为“正当”，邻车间来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当正当”，quite 修饰原级 valid。
valid 意为“正当”，no less valid than 表示“其正当不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之正当不亚于任何人的预料。
valid 意为“正当”，母亲 1982 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的正当理由”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，工程师在说明书里记下了一件有效的车票。（a valid ticket for the train）
它有效到车间里没有一个人敢靠近。（so valid that …）
母亲觉得它太有效，谁也用不上。（too valid to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩正当的理由。（a valid reason for the change）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩变革的正当理由一样正当。（as valid as …）
到了 1977 年，说明书上只剩半行字：要的是一件正当的东西。（something valid）
answers: In 1970 the engineer wrote of a valid ticket for the train in the manual.
It was so valid that nobody in the workshop would go near it.
My mother thought it too valid to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a valid reason for the change.
He said nobody would call it as valid as the reason for the change they had once had.
By 1977 the manual asked for nothing but something valid.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 valid 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the engineer wrote of a valid ticket for the train in the manual, and nobody forgot it.
It was the valid ticket for the train that anybody there had ever seen, or so the manual says.
My mother thought it too valid to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a valid reason for the change, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next workshop called the plan quite valid, and everybody laughed.
The valid ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
